rationale: Round 2 clarified the same core split rather than resolving it: labor and the state hold firm on no closures/no compulsory redundancies, while management, investors, and the family still insist those options remain on the table. There is some movement toward quantified scenarios and burden-sharing, but the discussion is circling around incompatible red lines, so a mediator-style intervention is needed before another round can produce anything substantive.
